summary.intent: Backfill missing Phase 47 SUMMARY.md files and Phase 48 VERIFICATION.md to fix false-positive GSD routing, then implement the missing PATCH /:shareId/item-name API endpoint so the already-built web backfill for legacy share itemName encryption can be enabled.
summary.outcome: All five Phase 47 summaries and Phase 48 VERIFICATION.md were written; a new PATCH endpoint with DTO, service method, controller handler, and specs was added to the API; the web backfillSentShareItemNames function was re-enabled and wired to the new endpoint; 171 API shares tests pass, web typechecks clean, committed to a feature branch in two logical commits.

repo: The GSD resume-incomplete-phase invariant checks SUMMARY.md file presence on disk, not git history — a phase can fully ship via PR and still trip the gate if summaries were never written, producing a false positive that would re-execute already-merged work.
Phase 47 shipped via PR #494 (commit d17d42e5f) and has a completed VERIFICATION.md, but its SUMMARY.md files were never written — a recurring bookkeeping gap pattern in this project.
backfillSentShareItemNames in the web share service was fully implemented but commented out pending a PATCH endpoint, waiting in apps/web/src/services/share.service.ts.
PATCH :shareId/encrypted-key in the shares controller is the canonical analog pattern for new per-field update endpoints — same ownership guard, same DTO structure, same service delegation.

pnpm api:generate must run after any new API endpoint to regenerate the typed client in packages/api-client/src/generated/; it bumps the OpenAPI spec version header on every generated file, producing many trivial 2+- diffs that are expected noise.
The web app has no dedicated typecheck script; tsc must be run directly against the tsconfig.

code.finding: The backfillSentShareItemNames call site had a void itemNameEncrypted — the value was computed but not persisted because the PATCH endpoint didn't exist yet.
New @Patch(':shareId/item-name') endpoint added, mirroring the encrypted-key handler pattern with ownership guard and DTO binding.
updateShareItemName method added directly after updateShareEncryptedKey; uses same ownership-check + prisma.share.update pattern.
New DTO mirroring UpdateEncryptedKeyDto; itemNameEncrypted field validation pattern taken from CreateShareDto.
Generated client gains new typed function for the item-name endpoint after api:generate; version header bumps from 0.38.0 to 0.39.0 across all generated files.

workflow: When the GSD resume-incomplete invariant fires, cross-check git log for a merged PR and existence of VERIFICATION.md before routing — a missing SUMMARY.md is not sufficient evidence that a phase is incomplete.
gsd_run query roadmap.analyze can return empty plan counts even when phases have content; fall back to direct directory listing (ls *-PLAN.md, *-SUMMARY.md) for reliable counts.
Committing in two logical units (feature vs. planning bookkeeping) keeps the feature diff reviewable and separates cosmetic documentation from code changes.
Excluding pre-existing untracked directories (.planning/intel/) from commits avoids accidentally capturing AI-generated research artifacts not owned by this session.

friction: GSD resume-incomplete-phase gate fired a false positive on Phase 47, nearly routing to re-execute already-merged refactors — required manual git log verification to override.
gsd_run query roadmap.analyze returned empty plan counts, forcing a fallback to raw directory listing to determine phase completeness.
Web app lacks a pnpm typecheck script; tsc had to be invoked directly, requiring manual tsconfig path lookup.
api:generate produces version-bumped headers on every generated file, making the diff noisy and requiring an extra inspection step to confirm the real change landed.
open_items: Milestone v1.1 is at 97% with Phase 48 now verified — /gsd-complete-milestone or a formal /gsd-verify-work 48 run still needed to close the milestone.
Phase 48 BLOCKED-HANDOFF (bin-restore e2e red) predated PRs #500/#504 — worth confirming the e2e suite is fully green post-merge before milestone close.
The underlying process gap (Phase 47 summaries never written at execution time) is unaddressed — future phases could hit the same false-positive resume gate.
The .planning/intel/ directory was untracked and excluded; its contents and ownership should be clarified.

Legacy shares that existed before this change still need their itemName encrypted on next access — the backfill only runs for the current user's sent shares on fetchAllSentShares, so any shares not loaded post-deploy will remain with plaintext itemName until accessed.
